title: Physically Consistent Parameter Inference: Transparent Machine Learning Emulation in High Energy Physics and Cosmology
abstract: arXiv:2607.12726v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Global fits in high energy physics and cosmology often face the challenge of exploring high-dimensional parameter spaces with computationally expensive or topologically complex likelihood functions. In this work, we present a Machine Learning framework designed to emulate complex, often non-Gaussian likelihood landscapes using gradient-boosted regression trees (XGBoost). We discuss the advantages of the Machine Learning approach in terms of computational efficiency and the resolution of confidence regions, particularly in scenarios with complex correlations or "curved" degeneracies. translated_title: 物理一致的参数推断：高能物理与宇宙学中的透明机器学习仿真
translated_abstract: 高能物理和宇宙学中的全局拟合常常面临探索高维参数空间的挑战，其似然函数往往计算代价高昂或拓扑结构复杂。在本工作中，我们提出了一个机器学习框架，旨在利用梯度提升回归树（XGBoost）来仿真复杂的、通常呈非高斯分布的似然地形。我们讨论了机器学习方法在计算效率和置信区域分辨率方面的优势，特别是在存在复杂相关性或“弯曲”简并的场景中。我们通过将该框架应用于最近一项关于半轻子B介子衰变中味反常的分析来验证该方法，并讨论了该框架对其他唯象系统（如类轴子粒子或宇宙学全局拟合）的适应性。最后，我们利用SHAP（Shapley Additive exPlanations）值提供了透明的分析。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于XGBoost梯度提升回归树的机器学习框架，可高效仿真高能物理和宇宙学全局拟合中复杂的非高斯似然函数，并借助SHAP值实现透明可解释的参数推断。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an XGBoost-based machine learning framework that efficiently emulates complex non-Gaussian likelihood landscapes in high energy physics and cosmology global fits, enabling transparent and interpretable parameter inference through SHAP values.
